data.title: 史黛菈 · 宿舍床榻的破军校服微解
data.description: 宿舍房门轻掩的静谧空间内，黄昏斜阳穿过窗纱洒落在单人床前。史黛菈端坐在床榻中央，破军学园的黑色制服外套半敞，红色领带微松，衬衫领口微微解开显出优美白皙的锁骨线条。绯红色的修长双马尾肆意披垂在肩头，平日好强的红莲皇女此刻双颊微红，眼波盈盈地凝视着前方，坦露出毫不设防的真心依恋。
data.action: 端坐在床榻中央，破军学园的黑色制服外套半敞，红色领带微松
data.lighting: warm amber sunset rays streaming through dormitory window
data.promptProse: Sitting in the center of her quiet dormitory bed as golden sunset streams through sheer curtains, Stella wears her Hagun Academy uniform with her black jacket unbuttoned, red tie loosened, and white shirt collar opened over her pale collarbone. Her high-slit red skirt and sheer black thighhighs rest along the rumpled quilt while she looks directly toward the viewer with a deeply flushed, ardent gaze. Warm amber dusk light catches her face and the edge of the bed.
data.animaCaption: Seated on her dorm bed with her black uniform blazer left open, red tie loosened, and shirt collar parted over her collarbone, Stella gazes straight ahead with a warm, deep blush. Golden sunset rays through the curtains light her skirt and black thighhighs.
data.nsfwProse: She wears her Hagun Academy uniform with her black blazer left unbuttoned, her red necktie loosened, and her white blouse collar parted to show her bare collarbone above her high-slit red pleated skirt and black thighhighs.
